Look someone in the group in the eyes and give them a sincere compliment.
Act out confessing your love to a pillow or a nearby object.
Sing a part of the love song you remember best.
Pose as if you were on the cover of a love-song album and hold it for a group photo.
Choose someone and act out accidentally meeting them in a romantic movie.
Make up a pickup line for the person opposite you.
Use three emojis to describe your ideal partner and let the group guess.
Dance confidently to a song the group chooses.
Imitate a famous character's voice and say, "I think I've fallen for you."
Let someone give you a new nickname to use until the end of the game.
Act out your ideal crush without speaking and let everyone guess.
Tell an imaginary love story in exactly three sentences.
Invent a secret handshake with the person next to you.
Sincerely thank someone in the group for something you appreciate about them.
Announce your own name like a host introducing the lead in a romantic movie.
Create an advertising slogan for yourself as the "ideal partner."
Choose someone and pose together like a coming-of-age movie poster.
Say a ridiculous pickup line in an extremely serious voice.
Act out your reaction if your crush suddenly texted, "I like you too."
Let the group choose an emotion, then act it out like a movie scene.
Say three positive things about the person sitting nearest to you.
Make up a love poem that includes the name of someone in the group.
Pretend to call your crush and ask them on a date.
Act out having your confession of love rejected in the funniest way you can.
Choose someone and make a heart shape together with your hands.
Say something you think would make someone blush.
Describe a perfect date as if you were a tour guide.
Play a TV host and introduce the person next to you like a star.
Flirt with someone using only your eyes and facial expressions, without speaking.
Do a catwalk as if you were arriving for a first date with your crush.
Name a song you would dedicate to someone in the group and explain why.
Act out receiving a message from your crush at midnight.
Make up a goodnight wish that is both sweet and funny.
Let the person next to you choose a word and turn it into a pickup line.
Play the lead in a breakup scene, but make the group laugh.
Use a nearby object as a prop and propose to it very formally.
Choose someone and invent a title for a romantic movie starring the two of you.
Give a compliment to the person you talk to least in the group.
Show three expressions: seeing your crush, getting a compliment from them, and being left on read.
Imagine you have won "Most Adorable Person of the Year" and give an acceptance speech.
Choose someone, give them a cute nickname, and explain it.
Use the names of three foods to create a meaningful declaration of love.
Act out how you think you would react if someone unexpectedly confessed their feelings for you.
Choose someone for a staring contest; whoever laughs first loses.
Strike a photo pose you think would catch your crush's attention.
Read any sentence on the screen in your most romantic voice.
Pretend to be a love expert and give the group a funny piece of advice.
Choose someone and act out a wedding photo shoot without laughing.
Invent an opening line for meeting a stranger that you would actually dare to use.
Send a hug through a gesture or words to the person in the group you most want to thank.
